In Key Lento, near Jason's house, a tall gray tower stands next to the clothing store Nifty Threads Islandwear. Climb over the chain-link gate, go through the gray door at its base and take the ladder all the way up: the Shrewsbury SM-69 sniper rifle waits on the balcony at the top. At Ammu-Nation it costs $1,850.
